ui_magic_link_sent: Check your inbox: we just sent you a link to sign in.
ui_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
ui_auth_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ui_otp_description: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to your email.
ui_otp_invalid_code: That code is not valid. Please check it and try again.
ui_user_not_logged: You need to sign in to see this content.
app_login_dev_notice: This demo has no mail server: the link and the code are printed on the server console.
app_home_intro: Every visible string on this page comes from the app, injected through the `strings` prop. Switch the language with the globe in the header: the library texts change too, because nothing is resolved at module scope.
app_home_session_in: Signed in as {email}. The user comes from `locals.user` through `+layout.server.ts`, one per request.
app_home_session_out: No session. Use the sign-in button in the header.
app_home_link_body: `Link` takes the key of the route map and resolves it with `resolve()`, so it respects `paths.base`. It can render the icon and the label of a route entry.
app_home_modal_body: `Modal` exposes `showModal()` and `close()`; the app keeps the reference with `bind:this`. The trigger can be replaced with the `trigger` snippet.
app_home_modal_content: A `<dialog>` from daisyUI. The X closes it, and so does clicking outside.
app_home_form_body: `zodToFieldsJsonSchema()` turns a zod object into a list of fields, and `FormFields` renders each kind (text, email, number, textarea, select, checkbox) with formsnap and superforms. Placeholders and descriptions come from `.meta()`.
app_home_not_logged_body: The notice for protected content. It does not open anything on its own: the action is a snippet the app fills in. Here it also shows the `class` prop overriding the library default (`min-h-screen` becomes `min-h-fit`).
app_admin_body: This page reads `locals.user` in its `+page.server.ts` and only returns the payload when there is a session. That is what replaces the `isProtected` flag removed from the route map: a label in a menu never protects anything.
